subject.why: Accurately represents the requested bridal bouquet with white, pink, and central red roses plus ribbons.

category.why: Floats cleanly in three-quarter view against a concentric ring background with no ground plane.

clean.why: Free of UI elements, text, borders, watermarks, and characters.

framing.why: Well-centered composition with adequate margins on all sides.

colour.why: Bright and saturated palette with good contrast against the green background.

detail.why: Features clean, simplified forms without noisy surface micro-details.

style.why: Matches the smooth, chunky 3D style and soft sheen of the references.
